problem:
Which of the following is a $2\times 2$ matrix?

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}3 & 3 \\ 3 & 3\end{aligned}],\,Q=[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}],\,R=[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ -1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

feedback.problem:
Which of the following is a $4\times 3$ matrix?

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}],\,M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 5 & \sqrt{2} & 7\end{aligned}],\,N=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
- The matrix $L$ has $4$ rows and $3$ columns. So, its dimensions are $4\times 3.$ $\,✓$

- The matrix $M$ has $3$ rows and $4$ columns. So, its dimensions are $3\times 4.$ $\,\times $

- The matrix $N$ has $2$ rows and $3$ columns. So, its dimensions are $2\times 3.$ $\,\times $

Therefore, only $L$ is a $4\times 3$ matrix.
